entities.name: Jérôme Haehnel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jérôme Haehnel is a retired French tennis player who is best known for defeating Andre Agassi in the first round of the French Open in 2004. Haehnel's career-high singles ranking is World No. 78, which he reached in February 2005. Jerome was coached by his wife and has a fear of flying.
